description: This file handles authentication flows with GitHub OAuth, including login, callback, and logout functions, as well as creating repositories and initial commits for new users.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Handles OAuth callback, exchanges code for access token, sets cookie, and redirects.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Checks existing access token, verifies user, creates repo and initial commit if first login.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears access token cookie and confirms logout.
